top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation turns ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis into a designable, catalytic chemical event with a mechanism defined at the level of ternary-complex structure, and cereblon gives thalidomide-type glues a chemical explanation; it has been reproduced independently in many laboratories and extended to targets without active sites. The citation can be written around induced proximity to an E3 ligase with Crews, Deshaies and Handa as the first demonstrators. I weigh mechanism and reproducibility above approval status, and I accept that the attribution cut against Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto and Kim is contestable. Base editing with Liu alone is my second choice: clean attribution and genuine nucleobase chemistry beyond the 2020 prize, but the targeting machinery is still CRISPR.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; his research on dNTP pools and ribonucleotide reductase has no direct link to any proposed laureate, though a biomedical orientation favours the degrader and base-editing proposals
